name: shakers
description: All-in-one local Shakers connector: scan your AI usage, build your profile, find projects, sign up, onboard and ask Alma — the full toolset runs on your machine and talks to Shakers over HTTP with your CLI login.
long_description: A local MCP server exposing the complete Shakers talent toolset. The local scan tools (ai_usage, read_cv, suggest_register_context) run on-device with on-device redaction; the server-backed tools (profile, projects, applications, certifications, sign-up, onboarding, roles, Alma) call hub/certs over HTTP authenticated with your Shakers CLI session. Includes slash-command prompts for the key actions.

tools.name: ai_usage
tools.description: Scan this machine's AI-tool sessions + git repos and (with consent) submit the redacted AI-usage report to Shakers.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Your Shakers profile: role, rate, and 'My work with AI'.

tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: Find open Shakers positions matched to you.

tools.name: signup_start
tools.description: Sign up on Shakers from the chat: the welcome and the steps, in your language.

tools.name: signup_email
tools.description: Choose the email your Shakers account is created with.

tools.name: signup_draft
tools.description: Review and confirm the profile draft prepared from your CV and LinkedIn.

tools.name: signup_create_account
tools.description: Import your LinkedIn and CV and open a window in your browser to create the account with a password or Google, or sign in.

tools.name: signup_status
tools.description: Progress of the sign-up: account and profile import per source.

tools.name: update_existing_profile
tools.description: If you already had an account: see what would change in your profile and decide whether to update it.

tools.name: save_profile_details
tools.description: Save the work situation, price, availability and languages inferred for your profile.

tools.name: import_profile
tools.description: Import LinkedIn, CV, GitHub or website into your signed-in profile, filling only empty fields.

tools.name: open_web
tools.description: Open Shakers in your browser already signed in (one-time link).

tools.name: open_linkedin_profile
tools.description: Open your own LinkedIn profile in your browser so you only copy its address into the chat.

tools.name: onboarding_interview_start
tools.description: Start the onboarding interview here in the chat (LiveKit is bundled; if it cannot load, the interview continues on the web).

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask Alma, the Shakers AI assistant.

tools.name: read_cv
tools.description: Read a CV file you confirmed is yours (local, with permission).

tools.name: suggest_register_context
tools.description: Content-free local hints (timezone, git identity, CV candidates) to speed up registration.
